# Stage A build dependencies committed in git.
#
# Electron 22.3.27 win32-x64 distribution: committed as PLAIN FILES in
# electron/ (the extracted official zip — no archives in the repo).
# Provenance: extracted from electron-v22.3.27-win32-x64.zip
#   sha256 ad723ed7dad32f9459f7a9de1fd6d718cf713c4809c2431503bea62ce8f786e6
# which matches the official release manifest:
#   https://github.com/electron/electron/releases/download/v22.3.27/SHASUMS256.txt
# (verified 2026-08-20, before extraction; the zip itself was then deleted).
# electron.exe (157,602,304 bytes, sha256
#   2ed9543796e0962bfcaae175794cfb1b3293f4f9e14fb1c3b37628f7cfd339cb)
# exceeds GitHub's 100MB file cap, so it is committed as two raw byte-slice
# parts (electron.exe.00.part 95MB + electron.exe.01.part ~55MB, checksums
# in electron.exe.parts.sha256 — same scheme as repack/setup-exe/).
# port-src/desktop/offline-win.cjs reassembles and verifies it on first run;
# the assembled file is gitignored. Parts are byte slices, not archives.
# `version` and `resources/default_app.asar` are absent from the tree on
# purpose — app-builder's unpack-electron removes both, so the extracted
# form reproduces the zip-path output byte-for-byte (verified: identical
# file set, 18076 asar entries, 122,023,120-byte installer).

# electron-builder NSIS toolchain cache (pre-populated, ~11 MB unpacked):
#   electron-builder-cache/nsis/nsis-3.0.4.1-nsis-3.0.4.1/
#   electron-builder-cache/nsis/nsis-resources-3.4.1-nsis-resources-3.4.1/
# Point ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE at vendor/electron-builder-cache/ and the
# Stage A build downloads nothing. Provenance: fetched by app-builder
# (download-artifact, sha512-verified against the checksums pinned in
# app-builder-lib 26.8.1 nsisUtil.js) from
#   https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder-binaries
#     releases/download/nsis-3.0.4.1/nsis-3.0.4.1.7z      (1,287,512 bytes)
#     releases/download/nsis-resources-3.4.1/nsis-resources-3.4.1.7z
#                                                          (  730,800 bytes)
# To re-verify from scratch: delete the cache dir and rebuild — app-builder
# re-downloads and sha512-checks both archives, then unpacks the same tree
# (cache hit is directory-presence; second run returns in ~16 ms).
# Layout verified on 2026-08-20 with app-builder 5.0.0-alpha.11.
